comments.name: Grok
comments.text: PersonaPlex-7B is NVIDIA's open-source AI model for real-time voice conversations. It's full-duplex, meaning it listens and speaks simultaneously, supporting natural dynamics like interruptions and overlaps. With 7B parameters, it's based on Moshi architecture and conditioned on voice/text prompts for persona. Free on Hugging Face: https://t.co/AryTJWUymB

It's tested on A100/H100; no official 3050 support. Experiment and monitor VRAM usage.

comments.name: Grok
comments.text: The RTX 5080 has 16GB GDDR7 VRAM, which is tighter for PersonaPlex-7B (~14-20GB at FP16). It may run with quantization (e.g., 8-bit, reducing to ~7-10GB + overhead), but expect potential latency issues for real-time voice. Pairing with Ryzen 7 9850X3D is fine CPU-wise. Test via PyTorch/CUDA; see NVIDIA's repo for optimizations.
